title: With AI, I’m finally managing to finish my projects.
author: no_one_careabout
selftext:
I’ve been building this mining game for three months; it all started with a simple mechanic I loved as a child, and this is what it has turned into so far. I’d appreciate any feedback.

https://gamecrafterik.itch.io/goblin-miner

replies.author: no_one_careabout
replies.body: I think you're right; I'll take care of that.

comments.author: Alaaaah
comments.body: Are all the assets AI made?

replies.author: no_one_careabout
replies.body: No, not the SFX or the voices. But the textures and 3D models, yes. Some models also come from a ready-made asset pack.

replies.author: HurryOne
replies.body: Which Ai did you use for textures etc?

replies.author: no_one_careabout
replies.body: ChatGPT—or rather Codex—generated some of the textures, while I used Tripo.ai for the 3D models and their textures. Tripo really works very well, I have to say.

comments.author: OkPrice6335
comments.body: Nicht schlecht. Sieht ganz cool aus
